changelog.change: Issue #519: privacy class, collection method, consent, opt-out, retention, minimum cell size, freshness, coverage, baseline, and target on every KPI; adds successful migration, first contribution, active maintainers, hosted-service adoption, repository availability, and independent mirror nodes.

weekDefinition: Monday 00:00 through Sunday 24:00 UTC; publish only after the week is complete
monthDefinition: First day 00:00 UTC through the last day 24:00 UTC; publish only after the month is complete
principles: A missing or incomplete source is unknown, never zero.
Acquisition metrics use first-touch attribution and exclude flagged bots by default.
An anonymous clone is a server-side snapshot delta; a copied clone URL is only an attributed intent signal.
Revenue and cost are closed-accounting measurements and are not inferred from product events.
No KPI may require a user or self-hosted operator to report anything; optional and operator-reported sources are labelled lower-bound or partial coverage.
Aggregates only leave the source system; a segment below its minimum cell size is suppressed.
A baseline or target is never invented: it is unmeasured or to-be-set until a recorded review adopts it.

decisionCadence.weekly: Activation-to-revenue scorecard (activation-revenue-scorecard.md): one action for the next week; no definition changes.
decisionCadence.monthly: Outcome review (outcome-review.md): every KPI, freshness, confidence, decisions, experiments, and roadmap changes.
decisionCadence.quarterly: Target review at a monthly outcome review: adopt, keep, or retire targets and publish any dictionary version change.

privacyClasses.public-aggregate: Derived from already-public records; publish aggregates only.
privacyClasses.pseudonymous-aggregate: Joined internally on an opaque or keyed index; only suppressed aggregates leave the source.
privacyClasses.consented-analytics: Collected only after explicit opt-in; coverage is partial by construction.
privacyClasses.confidential-finance: Billing and accounting records kept in finance systems; aggregates only.
privacyClasses.internal-operations: Staff and provider operational ledgers with no customer content.
privacyClasses.synthetic: Server-originated probes with no personal data.

collectionMethods.hosted-telemetry: Records the hosted service already keeps to operate.
collectionMethods.accounting-ledger: Closed billing, invoice, and support ledgers.
collectionMethods.operator-reported: Voluntary registrations or reports from self-hosted operators.

coverageClasses.full: The source observes the whole defined population.
coverageClasses.partial: Known exclusions (opt-outs, skip countries, consent) remove part of the population.
coverageClasses.lower-bound: Activity outside the hosted service is invisible by design; the value can only undercount.

aggregation.complementarySuppression: When exactly one segment is suppressed, the next smallest segment is suppressed too so the total cannot reveal it.

confidencePolicy.high: Reconciled, every required continuation exhausted, data cut fresh and after the window end, measured coverage at least 0.95, and full coverage class.
confidencePolicy.medium: Reconciled and fresh, but measured coverage below 0.95 or a partial or lower-bound coverage class.
confidencePolicy.low: Reconciled but stale, or measured coverage below 0.5.
confidencePolicy.unknown: Missing, unreconciled, not exhausted, or cut before the window ended; publish UNKNOWN, never zero.

metrics.label: Landing activation
metrics.definition: Distinct non-bot attribution sessions first seen during the week and containing the server-recorded landing_view event.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT attribution_sessions.id) where first_seen_at is in the week and landing_view is present
metrics.window: session first_seen_at in the week; report end is exclusive
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile the scorecard value to channel_report.totals.sessions and the collected session total; include excluded_bot_sessions separately.

pagination.continuation: Call collect_all until next_cursor is null and assert collected length equals total_count.

exclusions: is_bot=1 sessions unless the report is explicitly an audit view
DNT/GPC and configured EU/EEA skip-country visitors
crawler requests that never receive a session
metrics.privacyBoundary: Only an opaque session id is joined internally. Exports contain aggregate counts, source/campaign buckets, and no IP, full referrer, email, or path query string.
metrics.consent: No consent prompt: DNT/GPC visitors and configured EU/EEA skip-country visitors receive no cookie, session, or event.
metrics.optOut: Send DNT or Sec-GPC, or delete the session with DELETE /api/attribution/session from /privacy.
metrics.retention: Sessions and events are purged ATTRIBUTION_RETENTION_DAYS (default 400) after first_seen_at; the scorecard keeps weekly aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Anonymous clone
metrics.definition: The non-negative daily delta of cumulative clone counters for repositories whose mirror snapshots bracket the reporting day.
metrics.numerator: SUM(max(0, current attribution_clone_snapshots.clones_total - prior snapshot clones_total))
metrics.window: UTC snapshot days in the week
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile every repository-day delta to the two adjacent snapshots. A first-ever snapshot has no prior baseline and is excluded until the next snapshot.

pagination.reader: list_clone_snapshots and the snapshot cron's mirror_serve_counters reader
pagination.continuation: Follow every keyset cursor through collect_all; do not treat 100 repositories as the population.

exclusions: clone requests before the first snapshot
negative counter movement, clamped to zero
clone_url_copied events; those are not clones
metrics.privacyBoundary: The source counters are aggregated by public repository. The weekly export contains only the aggregate total; it is never joined to a browser, account, IP, or channel.
metrics.consent: None required: repository-level serve counters record no client, IP, or account.
metrics.optOut: Not applicable: no clone is attributable to a person. Mirrors that publish no counters are simply absent.
metrics.retention: Snapshot rows hold public per-repository cumulative counters and are not purged today; the scorecard keeps the weekly total.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Signup
metrics.definition: Distinct report sessions with a server-emitted signup_completed event in the week.
metrics.denominator: landing_activation for the same first-touch cohort when used as a conversion rate
metrics.window: signup_completed occurred_at in the week, constrained to sessions first seen in the selected acquisition range
metrics.reconciliation: Match the event count to channel_report.totals.signup_completed and separately report sessions whose first_utm_source is unknown.

pagination.continuation: Collect all continuation pages before grouping by session.

exclusions: signup_started without a completed account
bot sessions
accounts with no attribution session remain in the unknown bucket, not dropped
metrics.privacyBoundary: The attribution join uses a keyed user_bi internally. No email, password, IP, or account name enters the scorecard.
metrics.consent: No consent prompt: DNT/GPC visitors and configured EU/EEA skip-country visitors receive no cookie, session, or event.
metrics.optOut: Send DNT or Sec-GPC, or delete the session with DELETE /api/attribution/session from /privacy.
metrics.retention: Sessions and events are purged ATTRIBUTION_RETENTION_DAYS (default 400) after first_seen_at; the scorecard keeps weekly aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: First mirror
metrics.definition: Distinct attributed sessions whose linked account published its first repository through the catalog publish path during the week.
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile to accepted catalog publish records and require the linked signup session; an account without an attribution record is not backfilled into a channel.

pagination.continuation: Consume all event pages before deduplicating by session.

exclusions: repository metadata imports and non-published stubs
repeat repositories from the same owner
bot sessions
metrics.privacyBoundary: Repository identity is used only for operational reconciliation and is omitted from the aggregate scorecard.
metrics.consent: No consent prompt: DNT/GPC visitors and configured EU/EEA skip-country visitors receive no cookie, session, or event.
metrics.optOut: Send DNT or Sec-GPC, or delete the session with DELETE /api/attribution/session from /privacy.
metrics.retention: Sessions and events are purged ATTRIBUTION_RETENTION_DAYS (default 400) after first_seen_at; the scorecard keeps weekly aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Contribution
metrics.definition: Distinct attributed sessions with a contribution_made event, emitted after a new pull is accepted.
metrics.denominator: first_mirror for the contribution-after-mirror conversion view
metrics.reconciliation: Report both the deduplicated contributing-session count and, when needed, the raw accepted-pull ledger count; never label the former as number of pulls.

pagination.continuation: Collect all event pages before deduplicating by session.

exclusions: rejected, withdrawn, or malformed pulls
repeat events from the same session when presenting people activation
bot sessions
metrics.privacyBoundary: The report retains no pull body, diff, email, IP, or repository path; only aggregate attributed counts are published.
metrics.consent: No consent prompt: DNT/GPC visitors and configured EU/EEA skip-country visitors receive no cookie, session, or event.
metrics.optOut: Send DNT or Sec-GPC, or delete the session with DELETE /api/attribution/session from /privacy.
metrics.retention: Sessions and events are purged ATTRIBUTION_RETENTION_DAYS (default 400) after first_seen_at; the scorecard keeps weekly aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Managed-service qualification
metrics.definition: Discovery calls accepted by an operator for a managed-service waitlist submission; the waitlist submission count is the unqualified demand leading indicator.
metrics.reconciliation: Match each accepted conversation to an existing waitlist event using the keyed email index; a missing match is a failed reconciliation, not a new lead.

pagination.continuation: Read all waitlist and discovery event pages before joining.

exclusions: waitlist submissions not accepted by an operator
duplicate acceptance attempts
unverified or missing keyed email matches
metrics.privacyBoundary: The raw email is never in the event metadata; only a keyed blind index is used for the private admin join. The scorecard contains aggregate counts only.
metrics.consent: The submitter asks to be contacted about managed services; only a keyed email index joins the discovery record.
metrics.optOut: Withdraw the waitlist request; DNT/GPC sessions carry no attribution.
metrics.retention: Sessions and events are purged ATTRIBUTION_RETENTION_DAYS (default 400) after first_seen_at; the scorecard keeps weekly aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Paid conversion
metrics.definition: Customers that became paid in the closed accounting window divided by completed trials in that same window.
metrics.window: closed accounting period matching the week or explicitly labelled month-to-date
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile newPaidCustomers to the billing provider ledger and recognized invoice receipts; reconcile trialsCompleted to the approved trial register. Do not infer managed-service revenue while checkout is research-preview-not-for-sale.

pagination.reader: closed accounting export and provider ledger
pagination.continuation: If a provider export is paginated, exhaust every continuation token and retain the export row count.

exclusions: free accounts
refunds and failed payments until the accounting policy classifies them
synthetic or employee trials
managed checkout not yet enabled
metrics.privacyBoundary: The period file has aggregate counts and reconciliation references only; provider customer/subscription identifiers remain encrypted or in the billing system.
metrics.consent: Contractual billing record; no product tracking is added to measure it.
metrics.optOut: Not applicable: accounting obligation. Only aggregate counts leave the finance system.
metrics.retention: Provider and invoice records follow the accounting retention obligation; period files keep aggregates and evidence references.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Paid logo retention
metrics.definition: Paid accounts active at the end of the week that were also active at the beginning, divided by paid accounts active at the beginning.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(accounts active at week_start AND week_end)
metrics.window: week boundary snapshots; use the same timezone and billing status policy at both boundaries
metrics.reconciliation: Require retained week-start and week-end billing snapshots or provider exports. The current membership table alone is not historical evidence and must not be used to reconstruct prior weeks.

pagination.continuation: Exhaust every provider page for both boundary snapshots before joining on the keyed account id.

exclusions: free accounts
cancelled accounts after the policy-defined grace period
accounts with missing boundary status
new accounts without a week-start observation
metrics.privacyBoundary: Join on keyed account identifiers only; publish a rate and counts, never an account list or cancellation reason.
metrics.consent: Contractual billing record; no product tracking is added to measure it.
metrics.optOut: Not applicable: accounting obligation. Only aggregate counts leave the finance system.
metrics.retention: Week-boundary billing snapshots are kept only as long as the closed period needs them; the review keeps the rate and counts.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Feature adoption signal
metrics.unit: consented analytics identities by allowlisted action
metrics.definition: Distinct opted-in first-party analytics identities performing one of the fixed product actions during the week, reported by action; this is a directional signal, not total user adoption.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) grouped by fixed forkmesh_product_action
metrics.denominator: COUNT(DISTINCT opted-in distinct_id with any allowlisted action) only when explicitly labelled as opted-in coverage
metrics.window: Analytics event timestamp in the week
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile the export event total and distinct-id total to the export manifest. Label coverage as partial because consent is opt-in; never backfill non-consenting visitors as zero adoption.

pagination.reader: Analytics package export (GET /api/analytics/{org}/projects/{id}/export) or a trends query on forkmesh_product_action
pagination.continuation: The export is one bounded document; when it reports truncated, narrow the window and repeat. Retain pages_collected and provider_total.

exclusions: visitors without explicit analytics consent
DNT/GPC visitors
autocapture, pageview, session-recording, and free-form events
unknown action names
metrics.privacyBoundary: The client sends only fixed action names and coarse surfaces after consent. No raw path, query, referrer, text, account id, repository id, or session recording is used.
metrics.consent: Explicit opt-in on /privacy; analytics is off by default and DNT/GPC blocks it.
metrics.optOut: Withdraw the analytics choice on /privacy at any time.
metrics.retention: Provider project retention; the review export keeps weekly per-action aggregates only.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Support load
metrics.definition: Human hours spent on onboarding, migration, incident, administration, and other scoped support work for the period.
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile hours to the support time ledger and the six-gate supportReview evidence. Missing support entries make the period incomplete; they are not zero hours.

pagination.continuation: Exhaust all ledger pages or attach a signed row-count reconciliation.

exclusions: unscoped community discussion
automated alerts without human time
internal engineering time unless booked to support
metrics.privacyBoundary: The scorecard stores hours and sanitized evidence references, never ticket bodies, customer names, repository names, or private incident details.
metrics.consent: Staff time entries; no customer content is recorded in the ledger export.
metrics.optOut: Not applicable: operational ledger with no customer content.
metrics.retention: The support ledger keeps sanitized evidence references; the review keeps hours by category.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Infrastructure cost
metrics.definition: The sum of invoice-backed costs for every published service unit in scope, including provider usage, managed hosts, runners, and support where applicable.
metrics.window: closed accounting period; usage and invoices must cover the same interval
metrics.reconciliation: Reconcile each quantity to provider analytics and each costMicrousd value to an invoice, host ledger, runner ledger, or support ledger. Analytics unavailability and missing invoices stay unknown.

pagination.reader: Cloudflare analytics detail groups plus invoice/ledger exports
pagination.continuation: Exhaust bounded provider detail pages and verify detailTruncated is false; never assume the first provider page is all usage.

exclusions: unmeasured variable-cost units
unallocated shared cost without a reviewed allocation rule
free allowances treated as zero dollars without invoice reconciliation
metrics.privacyBoundary: Usage reporting is network aggregate. Cost exports contain quantities and evidence labels, not raw requests, paths, customer ids, repository data, or IPs.
metrics.consent: None required: network-aggregate provider usage and invoices.
metrics.retention: Invoices follow the accounting retention obligation; the review keeps quantities, costs, and evidence labels.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.definition: Recognized service revenue minus invoice-backed service cost, divided by recognized service revenue.
metrics.window: same closed accounting period as infrastructure_cost and paid_conversion
metrics.reconciliation: Run tools/unit_economics.py report on the period file. The report is complete only when every in-scope unit has source evidence and all required evidence fields are present; with zero revenue, margin is unknown rather than infinite.

pagination.continuation: Any source export feeding the period file must be fully collected before validation.

exclusions: unrecognized cash receipts
unmeasured or uninvoiceable service costs
periods with missing usageWindowComplete or evidence
zero-revenue periods reported as a percentage
metrics.privacyBoundary: Publish revenue, cost, profit, margin, target, and evidence status only; retain invoice and customer detail in finance systems.
metrics.consent: Contractual billing and invoice records; no product tracking is added to measure it.
metrics.optOut: Not applicable: accounting obligation. Only aggregate results leave the finance system.
metrics.retention: Invoice and customer detail stay in finance systems; the review keeps revenue, cost, profit, and margin.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Successful migration
metrics.definition: Provider migration runs that reached signed completion divided by runs that reached any terminal outcome during the month.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(repository_migration_runs) where outcome='completed' and finished_at is in the month
metrics.denominator: COUNT(repository_migration_runs) where outcome IN ('completed','abandoned','failed','rolled_back') and finished_at is in the month
metrics.window: finished_at in the UTC calendar month; runs still running are reported separately as in flight
metrics.reconciliation: The authenticated _migration_metrics view reads latest_1000_runs and is a diagnostic, not a monthly population. Publish only a finished_at-bounded export whose collected row count equals COUNT(*) for the same predicate, and reconcile completed runs to jobs carrying a non-empty signed state_hash.

pagination.reader: finished_at-bounded repository_migration_runs export ordered by finished_at, job_id, generation
pagination.continuation: Keyset on (finished_at, job_id, generation) until a short page; assert collected rows equal the COUNT(*) for the window.

exclusions: runs still running at the data cut
external listings with no transfer job
automated fixture jobs
the encrypted data column, which is never decrypted for this metric
metrics.privacyBoundary: Only provider, outcome, and duration columns are read. No repository id, owner_bi, checkpoint, or provider identifier enters the export; provider breakdowns obey the minimum cell size.
metrics.consent: Operational record of a migration the owner started; no additional tracking is added.
metrics.optOut: Migrations run on a self-hosted node never report. Deleting a job removes its runs.
metrics.retention: Run rows persist until their job is deleted; the review keeps monthly aggregates only.

guardrails.rule: setup p50 must stay at or below 180000 ms

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: First contribution
metrics.definition: Distinct public contributor identities whose cumulative contribution tally is positive at month end and was absent or zero at month start.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(author_bi with total > 0 in the month-end contributor_activity snapshot AND absent or total = 0 in the month-start snapshot)
metrics.window: difference between the UTC month-start and month-end boundary snapshots
metrics.reconciliation: contributor_activity is cumulative and keeps only last_ts, so a past month cannot be reconstructed from it. Both boundary snapshots must be retained; a missing snapshot makes the month UNKNOWN. The attributed contribution row is a different, session-grain measure and is never expected to match.

pagination.continuation: Keyset on author_bi until exhausted; the snapshot row count must equal COUNT(*) at the cut.

exclusions: contributions rejected before _record_contributor
display names and per-author tallies
renamed identities, which count as new and are an acknowledged overcount
metrics.privacyBoundary: The boundary snapshot keeps only author_bi and total, never names. Only the monthly count is published.
metrics.consent: Derived from contributions the author already published; no additional tracking is added.
metrics.optOut: Contributions that stay on a self-hosted node and never federate are not counted.
metrics.retention: Boundary snapshots are deleted once the month's review is recorded and the following month's start snapshot exists.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Active maintainers
metrics.definition: Distinct accounts that completed an owner-authorized web merge during the trailing 28 days ending at month end.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT actor_bi) from repo_merge_jobs where status='succeeded' and updated_at is in the trailing 28 days
metrics.window: 28 UTC days ending at the month-end boundary
metrics.reconciliation: Merge jobs expire after HTTPS_MIRROR_MERGE_JOB_RETENTION_MS (7 days), so a 28-day window needs daily exports of the distinct actor_bi set, unioned before counting. A missing daily export makes the value UNKNOWN. Merges made on a maintainer's own node or over SSH never touch this table.

pagination.reader: daily repo_merge_jobs export of distinct succeeded actor_bi
pagination.continuation: Keyset on (updated_at, request_id) until exhausted before taking the distinct set.

exclusions: failed or requested jobs
merges performed off the hosted merge path
repository and pull identifiers
metrics.privacyBoundary: Daily exports hold blind indexes only and are deleted after the month is reviewed; only the distinct count is published.
metrics.consent: Operational record of a merge the maintainer requested; no additional tracking is added.
metrics.optOut: Merge on your own node or over SSH; the hosted merge path is never required.
metrics.retention: Jobs expire after 7 days; daily blind-index exports are deleted after the monthly review.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Hosted-service adoption
metrics.definition: Owners with at least one ForkMesh-hosted repository divided by owners with at least one published repository, both at the month-end snapshot.
metrics.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT owner) with a catalog record whose source is HOSTED_SOURCE or a hosted import promoted by _promote_hosted_repository_import
metrics.denominator: COUNT(DISTINCT owner) with any published catalog record
metrics.reconciliation: Count both populations from the same snapshot. A hosted record taken over by the owner's signed node publication stops counting and is reported as a hosted-to-self-hosted transition, a portability success rather than churn. Payment is never inferred from hosting; paid rows reconcile to billing.

pagination.reader: month-end catalog snapshot grouped by owner
pagination.continuation: Keyset over catalog records until exhausted; the collected count must equal COUNT(*) at the cut.

exclusions: private repositories
external listings that are not hosted
deleted or archived records at the cut
metrics.privacyBoundary: Owners are counted by keyed index in the private snapshot; only the two counts and the rate are published.
metrics.consent: Derived from catalog records the owner published; no additional tracking is added.
metrics.optOut: Self-host the repository; a signed publication from your own node replaces the hosted record.
metrics.retention: The month-end snapshot is deleted after the review is recorded.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Repository availability
metrics.definition: Passed synthetic status samples divided by expected samples for the public repository read and clone systems, over completed UTC days.
metrics.numerator: SUM(checks - failures) over completed UTC days for the in-scope systems
metrics.denominator: SUM(expected samples) for the same systems and days; a missing sample lowers coverage and never counts as a pass
metrics.window: completed UTC days in the month
metrics.reconciliation: Status buckets keep STATUS_HISTORY_DAYS (30) days, so completed days are exported weekly; a day missing from the export is UNKNOWN, not available. Cross-check a sampled outage against the status alert log and the latest stock Git conformance report.

pagination.reader: weekly export of completed system_status_daily_batch days
pagination.continuation: One row per UTC day; assert the exported day count equals the completed days in the window.

exclusions: the current incomplete UTC day
systems outside the public read and clone path
deploy-grace samples, which are reported separately
metrics.privacyBoundary: Server-originated probes only; no user, repository content, or client address is recorded.
metrics.consent: None required: the samples are server-originated probes with no personal data.
metrics.retention: Status buckets keep 30 days; the review keeps daily aggregates.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods

metrics.label: Independent mirror nodes
metrics.definition: Median over UTC days of distinct mirror nodes holding a fresh account-bound active proof, split into the ForkMesh fleet and other operators.
metrics.numerator: MEDIAN(daily COUNT(DISTINCT node_bi) from mirror_https_endpoints where forkmesh_active=1 and forkmesh_verified_at is within HTTPS_MIRROR_STATUS_FRESH_MS of the sample)
metrics.window: one daily sample per UTC day in the month

source.locator: Four-step proof / 2. Add an independent mirror

metrics.reconciliation: Key liveness on the signed active proof, never on checked_at. The fleet split is by node_name GLOB 'mirror*'; other operators are the remainder. Reconcile a sampled day against the /status mirror roster.

pagination.continuation: Keyset on node_bi until exhausted; the status roster's STATUS_MIRROR_MAX cap does not bound this count.

exclusions: abuse-blocked endpoints
registrations without a fresh active proof
self-hosted nodes that never register, which are invisible by design and never probed or inferred
metrics.privacyBoundary: Endpoint registrations are voluntary public routing records. Only counts are published; region breakdowns obey the minimum cell size.
metrics.consent: An operator chooses to register a public endpoint; running ForkMesh never requires registration.
metrics.optOut: Do not register, or remove the endpoint; no heartbeat is required to self-host.
metrics.retention: Endpoint rows exist while registered; the review keeps daily counts.

baseline.establishedBy: the first COMPLETE period recorded after this dictionary version

target.decideAt: the first monthly review with two comparable baseline periods
